national-engine.title: The National Engine

index.title: The Index of True Measures
index.text: False signals no longer pass unchecked. You can read the economy’s gauges without being fooled by bad counts, missing categories, or nominal illusions.

valve.title: The Valve of Labor Flows
valve.text: The idle queue is not random. Separation and finding rates govern the flow, and the natural rate emerges from the machinery beneath the surface.

seal.title: The Equilibrium Seal
seal.text: The accounts close. Output, income, factor payments, saving, investment, and demand now stand before the same final balance.

mint-ash-gold.title: The Mint of Ash and Gold

reserve.title: The Reserve Key
reserve.text: The mint yields its first secret. Deposits become loans, loans become money, and the supply of currency answers to reserves, banks, and the hand that turns the central lever.

compass.title: The Golden Rule Compass
compass.text: The path to wealth is not printed into existence. Savings feed capital, capital deepens production, and the highest sustainable living standard lies where accumulation is guided, not worshiped.

crown.title: The Stabilization Crown
crown.text: The storm bends, but the long run does not kneel. Demand may surge, supply may fracture, and output may wander, but the economy is drawn back toward its deeper balance.

command-nexus.title: The Command Nexus

atlas.title: The Atlas of Demand
atlas.text: The first map locks into place. Spending, investment, and interest-rate pressure no longer scatter across the table. You can trace the path of demand and see where output begins to move.

dial.title: The Calibrated Dial
dial.text: The rate holds steady under pressure. Money demand, money supply, income, and interest now answer to the same mechanism. The short-run system can be adjusted without guessing.

lens.title: The Stabilizer’s Lens
lens.text: The shock is no longer hidden. Fiscal force, monetary response, aggregate demand, and crisis signals come into focus. The Nexus does not promise certainty. It reveals the pressure points.

exchange-citadel.title: The Exchange Citadel

ledger.title: National Ledger
ledger.text: The National Ledger locks the first identities into place: output, domestic spending, saving, investment, net exports, and net capital outflow.

charter.title: Policy Charter
charter.text: The Policy Charter marks command over fiscal policy, investment shifts, capital flows, real exchange rates, trade balances, tariffs, and currency adjustment.

pen.title: Pen of Exchange
pen.text: The Pen of Exchange restores final authority over Mundell-Fleming logic, fixed and floating exchange-rate regimes, the impossible trinity, and open-economy aggregate demand.
